departure.note: Aggregate ADE only; no per-voyage breakdown was saved for this or any other modern forecaster (DLinear/PatchTST/Informer/Autoformer/FEDformer/TimesNet), and its test set (n=113) is NOT the same voyage set as TrajRAG's matched n=63 subset -- so no paired per-voyage comparison or Wilcoxon test against iTransformer is possible from saved outputs.
